doc: PROFILE.md 5.1, normative entry for this step's spatial-reference change: 'PROJJSON in SRS metadata -- `pdal info --metadata` grows a `srs.json` member carrying the PROJJSON description of the file's coordinate system. At this release it is an escaped JSON string; it becomes a nested object later.' -- the member is spelled srs.json in the binary. Measured on the real anchors: at 2.4.0 the srs object has ten keys and no json; at 2.5.0 it has eleven, the new one being json. prettycompoundwkt is asserted alongside it so that 'additive' is tested too.
